authority: CEO R334 — buyer objection intelligence + commercial KA example

objection_taxonomy.integration: Buyer says integration into existing product line is too complex
objection_taxonomy.cost: Buyer says development cost is too high for expected return
objection_taxonomy.regulatory: Buyer says regulatory pathway is too uncertain or expensive
objection_taxonomy.performance: Buyer says demonstrated performance is insufficient for their application
objection_taxonomy.manufacturing: Buyer says they cannot manufacture the technology at scale
objection_taxonomy.market: Buyer says market size or timing is wrong for their strategy
objection_taxonomy.competitive: Buyer says a competitor already has something similar
objection_taxonomy.ip: Buyer says IP position is unclear or threatened
objection_taxonomy.clinical: Buyer says clinical evidence is insufficient for their medical affairs team
objection_taxonomy.timeline: Buyer says development timeline is too long for their planning horizon

example_commercial_ka.frequency: 3 out of 4 buyers mentioned integration burden for P-16; 1 mentioned it for P-15
example_commercial_ka.commercial_action: Redesign buyer package to include integration case study and reduce perceived burden. Consider developing reference integration architecture.
example_commercial_ka.scientific_action: NONE — commercial objection does not change T2-CONFIRMED status of P-16
example_commercial_ka.ai_priority_influence: When searching for new candidates, prefer mechanisms with lower integration burden (e.g., surface coatings over active electronics)

buyer_feedback_to_ai_loop.flow: buyer_interactions → objection_extraction → clustering → commercial_KA → ai_design_priority → new_experiment → technology_update → new_buyer_package
buyer_feedback_to_ai_loop.example: 3 buyers say P-16 integration is too hard → CKA-001 created → AI prioritizes simpler integration in next candidate search → new candidate P-24 designed with lower integration burden → new buyer package emphasizes simplicity
buyer_feedback_to_ai_loop.critical_rule: Commercial KA influences CANDIDATE SEARCH and PACKAGING, NOT TECHNICAL STATE. P-16 remains T2-CONFIRMED regardless of buyer objections.
